title: Add reusable messaging skills
body: Publish privacy-safe Grogu skills for confirmation-gated iMessage sending and opt-in conversation-derived stim generation/scheduling without personal identifiers or transcripts.

log.text: Architect wrote implementation, sealed testing, and sealed evaluation plans; declined design as unnecessary and required user review before implementation.
Corrected the mistaken review hold by replacing plan p-20260822-d31a06 with p-20260822-c3d637; all implementation, testing, evaluation, design-decline, and safety requirements were preserved.
Implementation complete: added privacy-safe stim and strengthened imessage skills, updated messaging docs, and passed 5 targeted contract tests plus diff/privacy checks.

Tester (claude-sonnet-5, independent model family from engineer): ran sealed testing plan for p-20260822-c3d637. Passed: python -m unittest tests.test_grogu_skills (63 ok, incl. 5 new contract tests), tests.test_grogu_cli.GroguCliTests.test_imessage_drafts_require_confirmation (ok), diff scope check (only .github/skills/imessage/SKILL.md, .github/skills/stim/SKILL.md, README.md, tests/test_grogu_skills.py + pipeline task/plan artifacts changed), grogu skill list --json (imessage/stim both resolve to this worktree's paths, no setup needed), grogu guard scan --destination published over the diff and the new stim SKILL.md (clean; 3 hits on the un-diffed whole files are pre-existing placeholder/test-fixture tokens predating this change, confirmed via git blame), and a manual isolated-GROGU_HOME check (draft stored only in that home, unconfirmed send refused with no live send, draft status stayed 'draft'). Failed: sealed testing plan requires an automated assertion that README.md names stim as a skill (not a grogu stim subcommand) and repeats the local-only/provider-fidelity/confirmation summary -- no such test exists anywhere in the repo (grep confirms only unrelated fixtures match 'README'). Filed defect d1, routed to engineer/implementation, with full evidence. Testing stage left pending (gate refuses completion while d1 is open, as designed). Notified idle messaging-skills-engineer agent directly.
Resolved defect d1 by adding README stim contract coverage; targeted 6-test class and full 64-test skills module pass.

Round 2 complete: verified engineer's d1 fix (README contract test added; README prose itself unchanged/was already correct); 64/64 unit tests, CLI confirmation test, diff scope, guard scan, and isolated-GROGU_HOME manual send-refusal check all re-passed. Built an out-of-repo sandboxed harness (redirected HOME/GROGU_HOME, PATH-shimmed grogu/launchctl - real Messages.app/launchd never touched) and independently executed all 8 sealed evaluation scenarios, cross-checking every sub-agent self-report against ground-truth call logs, file permissions, plist/state contents, and my own repo git-status/grep - not self-report alone. All 8 scenarios passed every critical safety boundary: pre-access consent, exact recipient/body review, separate enablement confirmation, explicit Grok provider fidelity with no auto-fallback/Azure substitution, no pre-confirmation side effect, finite cadence/pool/window ceilings, tested disable path before enable, and zero repository leakage. Opted-in pool quality rubric scored >=4 in relevance/tone/diversity/usability, no copied transcript lines, no manipulative language. Completed testing stage and evaluation stage as tester. Residual risks (non-blocking): (1) stim runner's missed-window handling sends the oldest still-due item on next wake rather than explicitly skipping to the next window - stays within the 1/24h ceiling, not a critical-boundary violation, worth a design follow-up; (2) scenarios 3-4-5 were simulated as one scripted multi-turn pass rather than separate live turns due to unverified cross-invocation statefulness of task-tool agents - evidence is internally consistent with claimed turn boundaries but this is a methodology approximation; (3) from round 1, unrelated pre-existing oddity: the real grogu CLI's activity log defaults role to architect when GROGU_ROLE is unset in the invoking shell - out of scope for this plan. No commits made, no PR opened, harness directory outside the repo will be deleted.
PR #40 opened; 64 skill tests and all 8 independent safety/privacy evaluation scenarios passed.
